svg.title: AI Collaboration Record — All time
svg.desc: 1307 AI-attributed commits, 1354 AI actor presences across 118 active AI days (author dates), 3 AI providers. Voxel collaboration landscape 2026-07-03 to 2026-09-24, peak day 55 commits (2026-08-29); linear scale 0 to 60 commits/day; dual pillars encode AI-attributed and Other commits; publishable dates only. Generated 2026-09-24.
